scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sage/contracts && npm run dev:watch
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n contracts,api,web -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev -w @sage/contracts" "npm run dev -w @sage/api" "npm run dev -w @sage/web"
scripts.lint: npm run build --workspace @sage/contracts && npm run lint --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @sage/contracts && npm run test --workspaces
